selection_rule: include all five initial candidate families

exception_policy.automatic_disposition: Different source lines are retained as separate senses, including when their family labels differ.
exception_policy.human_queue: Do not treat multi-sense family variation as an exception; review classifier errors through held-out family pools.

human_review.review_note: The starter examples are direct noun-equivalence definitions; review should focus on ambiguous or non-equivalence entries rather than the obvious cases.
Starter batch accepted: words describing a person by what that person does.

samples: One who uses an abacus in casting accounts; a calculator.
One who steals and drives away cattle or beasts by herds or droves.

human_review.review_note: Starter batch accepted: words naming an action or process.

samples: The act of abalienating; alienation; estrangement.
The act of abdicating; the renunciation of a high office.

human_review.review_note: Starter batch accepted: definitions identify an object's use or purpose.

samples: A material of wool or silk used for working the figures in embroidery.
An itinerant licensed dealer in commodities used for food.
A plane used for cutting out grooves and inlaying strings and bands.

human_review.review_note: Starter batch accepted: definitions identify class membership and an alternate name.

samples: One of the tiles or squares of a tessellated pavement; an abaculus.
One of the genus Aphis; an aphidian.
One of the aphides; an aphid.
One of the Araneina; a spider.

exceptions.reason: The same headword also has an adjective sense; retain noun and adjective entries separately.

review_requirements: confirm or revise the proposed relation schema
mark each sample as valid, invalid, or requiring a different family
identify surface variants suitable for held-out evaluation
allow overlapping structural relations instead of assuming mutually exclusive families
audit negative controls for target-family incompatibility
identify unresolved referenced terms that require dictionary navigation
